source_law.text: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: Both intersecting highways are two-directional: The approach for a left turn must be made in that portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline thereof.

requirement_dispositions.branch: Left-turn approach where both intersecting highways are two-directional
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Source reviewed; exact approach geometry, Native controller, four candidate proofs per selected case, saved audits, and physical realization remain pending.

measurement_contract_draft.primary_quantity: ego lateral placement relative to the native centerline during the approach
measurement_contract_draft.reference_frame: road-aligned station and lateral coordinates on the approached highway
measurement_contract_draft.window: from stabilized approach until the front vehicle footprint first enters the intersection
raw_evidence: time stamped ego pose and full footprint vertices
native centerline polyline and lane direction
native intersection boundary and entry time
intended turn declaration and measured route/heading after intersection
measurement_contract_draft.comparison: compare the two requested approach placements under the same road geometry, actor, turn route, controller policy, capture rate, and camera policy; record any changed engineering parameter
measurement_contract_draft.acceptance_limit: No universal metre cutoff is assigned to the statutory word nearest; preserve measured lateral offsets and lane adjacency for later review
measurement_contract_draft.engineering_tracking_window: native ego center x=-35..-10 m, sampled at 20 Hz before intersection entry
measurement_contract_draft.statutory_note: The 0.35 m tolerance diagnoses controller tracking only and is not a legal nearest-centerline threshold.
measurement_contract_draft.prototype: native/measure.py computes sampled centerline offsets, full-body right-half occupancy, intersection-entry time bracket, and observed northbound exit; no legal threshold or verdict.

candidate_risks_draft.measured_trigger: Native waypoint graph has no connected path from selected incoming lane to northbound destination, or turn completion=false by 24 s
candidate_risks_draft.possible_engineering_knob: Move turn entry station from x=-7 m to x=-10 m and regenerate only the internal turn path while retaining approach placement, legal context and comparison variable

candidate_risks_draft.risk: lateral tracking misses selected approach placement
candidate_risks_draft.measured_trigger: Maximum native body-center lateral tracking error on x=-35..-10 m exceeds 0.35 m, with 20 Hz samples and full body history retained
candidate_risks_draft.possible_engineering_knob: Adjust pure-pursuit lookahead from 4.0 m to 3.0 m in both paired cases; retain identical speed target and path geometry

candidate_risks_draft.risk: near and far approach position cannot be inspected in primary video
candidate_risks_draft.measured_trigger: Independent saved-pixel audit cannot identify the centerline and complete ego body in at least 95% of 20 Hz approach frames x=-35..-10 m
